title: Sample-Grained Approximate Unlearning with Provable Per-Sample Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2611.04501v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to erase the influence of a designated forget set from a trained model while preserving strong utility on the retain set. Approximate unlearning methods efficiently achieve this goal without full retraining, but their effectiveness is primarily assessed using dataset-level aggregate metrics. These aggregate metrics can mask deviations from retraining at the level of individual samples. In this work, we focus on per-sample unlearning effectiveness. We introduce SALA (Sample-grained Likelihoods ALignment), a plug-in optimization framework that enables approximate unlearning methods to operate at the level of individual samples by steering each example toward its correct target distribution. To quantitatively assess this behavior, we further propose the sample-grained distribution gap, a metric that captures per-sample discrepancies between approximate unlearning and exact retraining output distributions. translated_title: 样本粒度近似遗忘与可证明的逐样本边界
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘旨在从训练好的模型中消除指定遗忘集的影响，同时保持模型在保留集上的强效用。近似遗忘方法无需完整重训练即可高效实现这一目标，但其有效性主要通过数据集层面的聚合指标来评估。这些聚合指标可能掩盖个别样本层面上与重训练结果的偏差。在本工作中，我们关注逐样本的遗忘有效性。我们提出了SALA（Sample-grained Likelihoods ALignment，样本级似然对齐），这是一个即插即用的优化框架，通过将每个样本引导至其正确的目标分布，使近似遗忘方法能够在单个样本层面运行。为了定量评估这一行为，我们进一步提出了样本粒度分布差距这一指标，用于捕捉近似遗忘与精确重训练输出分布之间的逐样本差异。我们证明（摘要原文在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出SALA即插即用优化框架和样本粒度分布差距指标，使近似机器遗忘方法能够在逐样本层面工作，并提供了可证明的逐样本遗忘边界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SALA, a plug-in optimization framework, together with a sample-grained distribution gap metric, enabling approximate unlearning methods to operate at the per-sample level with provable per-sample bounds.
